explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and also 0 at D2 whenever the agent chose a2; it is only nonzero at D2 on a1 trials. On an a1 trial, it is near 10 if the previous trial went unrewarded (10 when S1 is reached through the common transition, 8-9 when S2 is reached through the rare one); after rewarded trials it falls with each additional reward in a row (about 7, then 5, 4, 3, 2, 1), and reaching S2 through a rare transition after a reward gives about 2 points less (about 5 right after one reward, 0-1 during long reward runs).
